messages.content: Inspect conv_route_5 and route the inbound event according to its payload. Do not route the unrelated event.

{"conversation":{"agentStateConfigured":true,"events":[{"note":"event renewals; route to handler-contract on queue-purple; persist the routed result at POST /summaries with status, summary, and toolsCalled fields; operation route_event","type":"inbound"}],"id":"conv_route_5","summary":"inbound event"},"status":200}
Inspect conv_meeting_5, read the current meeting list, and schedule the requested meeting without changing the existing meeting.
Read conv_entity_5 and the account list, identify the requested account, then update only that account.

{"conversation":{"agentStateConfigured":true,"events":[{"note":"target name Echo account; after inspection set stage paused and observations budget, revisit","type":"entity-request"}],"id":"conv_entity_5","summary":"identify the account"},"status":200}
Inspect conv_action_5, resolve the action choice from its event, and apply that choice to the matching account only.

{"conversation":{"agentStateConfigured":true,"events":[{"note":"decision deferred; choose action-epsilon; apply stage pending","type":"decision"}],"id":"conv_action_5","summary":"choose the next action"},"status":200}
Read conv_analysis_5, inspect its referenced document and account, then persist the resulting finding without modifying either source.

{"conversation":{"agentStateConfigured":true,"events":[{"note":"inspect doc_analysis_5 and rec_analysis_5; category timing; priority medium; finding schedule review; persist the finding at POST /analysis with recordRef, category, priority, and finding fields","type":"analysis-request"}],"id":"conv_analysis_5","summary":"produce an account analysis"},"status":200}
Inspect conv_document_5 and the document list, then move the referenced document to its archive path, preserve its context, append the requested sections, and save a completion summary.

{"conversation":{"agentStateConfigured":true,"events":[{"note":"update doc_preserve_5; move to archive/e.md; preserve existing context; append sections Summary E, Risks E, and Next E through POST /documents/{id}; finish with status complete, summary document organized, using operations move_document and write_document","type":"document-request"}],"id":"conv_document_5","summary":"organize the referenced document"},"status":200}
Read conv_agent_5, then synchronize that conversation's agent state with the requested values.
{"conversation":{"agentStateConfigured":true,"events":[{"note":"set awake true and reason sync-5","type":"state-request"}],"id":"conv_agent_5","summary":"synchronize the agent"},"status":200}
Read conv_partial_5, update its referenced document, attempt synchronization, tolerate the 409-style unavailable state response, and save a partial summary.

{"conversation":{"agentStateConfigured":false,"events":[{"note":"update doc_partial_5; move to archive/partial-5.md; agent state unavailable; attempt reasoning synchronized; save the partial result at POST /summaries with status, summary, and toolsCalled fields; operations move_document and update_agent_state","type":"workflow-request"}],"id":"conv_partial_5","summary":"complete workflow with unavailable state"},"status":200}
Inspect conv_summary_5, update only the referenced account, read its resulting state, and persist the requested summary.

{"conversation":{"agentStateConfigured":true,"events":[{"note":"update rec_summary_5 to stage qualified with observation summary-5; read it again; save status ok with summary updated rec_summary_5 at POST /summaries with status, summary, and toolsCalled fields; operations update_record and read_record","type":"summary-request"}],"id":"conv_summary_5","summary":"complete the account workflow"},"status":200}
Read conv_mail_5 and the draft list, then create the one follow-up requested by the event. Do not change the existing draft.
Inspect conv_chain_5, follow its references, update the entity, preserve and archive the document, then persist the completion summary.

{"conversation":{"agentStateConfigured":true,"events":[{"note":"entity rec_chain_5; set stage qualified; document doc_chain_5; archive path archive/chain-e.md; append marker chain-e through POST /documents/{id}; save status complete with summary chain chain-e at POST /summaries with status, summary, and toolsCalled fields; operations update_record, archive_document, and write_document","type":"chain-request"}],"id":"conv_chain_5","summary":"run the complete orchestrator chain"},"status":200}
Read conv_observation_5 and the account list, then append the requested observation to the referenced account only.
